about.label: Our App
about.subtitle: Tired of dead WhatsApp groups, no-shows, and impossible bookings? PachangApp centralizes everything so you only have to worry about getting on the field and playing.
about.origin_title: From a Class Project to the Real Field.
about.p1: It all started as a Higher Degree Project in Web Application Development (DAW).
about.p1_end: saw very clearly that the way to organize pickup games in our city was obsolete: the friction of adding exactly 10 players breaks the magic of amateur sport.
about.p2_end: didn't hesitate to jump on board. We both saw the huge potential to automate bookings, connect unknown players, and gamify the experience of the classic 'Paco, are you coming today?'.
about.p3: Thus PachangApp was born: by and for football fans tired of chat group bureaucracy.
about.mission_title: We Play on the Same Team
about.mission_sub: We believe sport is the original social network. Our mission is to break down logistical barriers so anyone, at any time, can play a quality match.
about.offer_sub: Features designed specifically for the amateur football ecosystem.
about.final_title: Make Your Next Pickup Game Easier.
about.final_sub: Don't wait any longer. Join, choose your position, check the stats and prove who's boss on the field.
about.footer: Made with passion by Ibrahim and Pablo · © 2026 PachangApp
about.ibrahim_desc: The brain behind the initial idea. Fan of clean code and one-touch play.
about.pablo_desc: Tech-savvy obsessed with scalability and the ball always hitting the top corner.

features.f1_desc: Fuentenueva or Cartuja? Search for availability and book without making a single call.
features.f2_desc: Find pickup games near you, see who's playing and apply for free spots.
features.f3_desc: Organize your own. Define level, spots, price and we'll take care of filling it.
features.f4_desc: Elevate your group's level by creating automatic private leagues with rankings.
features.f5_desc: Your matches played, your goals, your karma. All centralized in your public profile.

roadmap.phase1_desc: Launch in our hometown. Closing exclusives with key sports centers and creating the first big community.
roadmap.phase2_desc: Bring the solution to the rest of Andalusia, scaling the Backend infrastructure and optimizing for mobile.
roadmap.phase3_desc: Padel, Basketball, Tennis... If it requires a team and a field, PachangApp will structure it across the country.

testimonials.t1_text: "I came to study in Granada and didn't know anyone. Thanks to this crew I already have a fixed team for Thursdays in Fuentenueva. It's just what was needed!"
testimonials.t2_text: "I'm the typical sucker who has to find a field and coordinate schedules every week. This saves my whole life of headaches. Super intuitive too."
